title: Mean Field Games of Optimal Trading with an SPDE Model of the Limit Order Book
abstract: arXiv:2610.38988v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop a mean field game (MFG) model for optimal trading in which the interaction among traders is mediated by the dynamics of the limit order book. The bid- and ask-side order densities are modeled as stochastic processes taking values in infinite-dimensional function spaces, and solve semilinear stochastic partial differential equations (SPDEs) with stochastic, time-varying order submission rates and multiplicative infinite-dimensional noise. This extends an existing limit order book framework to capture the aggregate impact of strategic traders executing market orders on the order densities. In this way, trading activity affects the order densities, which determine the market depths near the best quotes and hence the mid-price, and the mid-price, in turn, affects the traders' decisions. We establish the well-posedness and regularity of the resulting density-price system and use it to formulate an $N$-player optimal trading gam

translated_title: 基于限价订单簿SPDE模型的最优交易平均场博弈
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个用于最优交易的平均场博弈（MFG）模型，其中交易者之间的互动通过限价订单簿的动态来传递。买方和卖方两侧的订单密度被建模为在无限维函数空间中取值的随机过程，并求解带有随机时变订单提交率和乘性无限维噪声的半线性随机偏微分方程（SPDEs）。这扩展了现有的限价订单簿框架，以捕捉执行市价订单的策略性交易者对订单密度的综合影响。通过这种方式，交易活动影响订单密度，订单密度决定最优报价附近的市场深度进而决定中间价，而中间价反过来又影响交易者的决策。我们建立了由此产生的密度-价格系统的适定性和正则性，并用它来构建一个N玩家最优交易博弈……
tldr: 本文提出了一个交易者互动通过限价订单簿SPDE动态传递的平均场博弈最优交易模型，将订单密度建模为无限维随机过程，并建立了密度-价格系统的适定性与正则性。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a mean field game model for optimal trading in which trader interactions are mediated by SPDE-driven limit order book dynamics, modeling order densities as infinite-dimensional stochastic processes and establishing well-posedness and regularity of the resulting density-price system.
